prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A chubby, round cartoon cat drawn in a simple, flat children's picture-book style. The cat has bright butter-yellow fur all over, a soft pear-shaped body, a large round head merged with its body almost without a neck, small triangular ears, a tiny tail, and short stubby arms and legs. It is laughing hysterically: its mouth is stretched enormously wide open, taking up nearly half its face, showing a dark red mouth interior and a pink tongue. Its eyes are squeezed shut into thick, upward-curved arcs like "^ ^", with a few small tear drops flying from the corners. It has round pink blush circles on its cheeks. Its whole body leans back and shakes from laughter, and one stubby paw points forward at the viewer as if mocking them. Thick, clean black outlines, bold flat colors, minimal shading, smooth vector cartoon look, cute but slightly goofy and smug expression. Plain white background, centered composition, single character, looks like an exaggerated reaction sticker or emoji, high resolution.
